World map practice

This short demonstration uses 12 geographically varied country maps. Type each country name from memory and review the immediate feedback.

Time: The activity ends after 12 scored responses or four minutes, after the current response is complete.

Language: Authored lesson content is in English.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.77 + .665 * pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60, 0), p.overallOutcomeHistory.length), .966)+ .51* (p.stimSuccessCount) + 11.1 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown, .443); p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y)); return p
